desc:
🔥 Welcome to KJ Battlegrounds!

👊 Dominate them all, become the strongest 

⭐ Enjoying the game?
❤️ Please consider liking and favoriting to help us push more updates!

📱💻🎮 This experience works on all devices (CONSOLE, PC, MOBILE).

🖥️ Keybinds:
Awakening -  PC: G | Console: DPad Up
Block -  PC: F | Console: X
Punch -  PC: M1 | Console: B
Dash -  PC: Left click | Console: Y
Emote wheel - PC: B

This game includes randomized rewards (emotes). All items have an equal chance of being obtained. No duplicates are possible.

Join our group for updates and exclusive content:
https://www.roblox.com/communities/665808429/The-KJ-Battlegrounds-Studios#!/about
